# Cheatography

> A community-driven platform for creating, sharing, and discovering free cheat sheets across programming languages, tools, and technologies.

Cheatography hosts thousands of user-generated and curated cheat sheets covering languages like Bash, Linux, Java, JavaScript, Python, and many others. The platform enables developers and learners to both access quick-reference materials and contribute their own sheets to help the community.

## Key Topics

- Bash
- Linux
- Java
- Python
- JavaScript
- Regular Expressions
- AngularJS
- Vim
- Quick Reference
- Cheat Sheets
- Programming
- Developer Tools
- Free Resources
- User-Generated Content
- Learning Tools

## Browse & Explore

- [Cheatography Homepage](https://cheatography.com): Main hub for discovering free cheat sheets for Bash, Linux, Java, and more
- [Browse Cheat Sheets](https://cheatography.com/explore): Browse and explore cheat sheets organized by category for Python, JavaScript, Bash, and other technologies
- [Software Cheat Sheets](https://cheatography.com/software): Reference library of 1489+ software cheat sheets covering Vim, Linux, Bash tools, and developer utilities

## Create & Contribute

- [Create New Cheat Sheet](https://cheatography.com/replacethis/cheat-sheets/new): Create original cheat sheets for Bash, Linux, Java, and other programming languages
- [Add External Link](https://cheatography.com/replacethis/cheat-sheets/new-link): Contribute external links to cheat sheets covering AngularJS and other technologies
- [Upload Cheat Sheet File](https://cheatography.com/replacethis/cheat-sheets/new-upload): Upload cheat sheet files for Bash, Linux, Java, and other programming languages

## User Account & Community

- [Saved Favorites](https://cheatography.com/favourites): View and manage your saved favorite cheat sheets
- [Messages](https://cheatography.com/messages): Community messaging system for connecting with other cheat sheet creators and users
